lines.vo: Why does your weekly to do list never fit inside the week?
That's not laziness. It's called the planning fallacy.
Tasha maps out her week in her Life Reset Planner, and this time she adds extra time to every task.

lines.vo: Your brain pictures the best case, not the interruptions.
